annotations.title: Reverse-lookup 4-byte function selectors and 32-byte event topics to signatures

description: Reverse-lookup 4-byte function selectors and 32-byte event topics to signatures. Looks up up to 20 selectors (0x + 8 hex) and event topics (0x + 64 hex) in the public openchain signature database (4byte.directory fallback) and returns candidate signatures, verified-contract ones first. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
name: evm_selector_lookup
title: Reverse-lookup 4-byte function selectors and 32-byte event topics to signatures
